parameter_sets.evidence: The global leaky-integrate-and-fire values used by the Shiu et al. 2024 whole-brain model of a different connectome. They are the project engineering fallback for every cell type with no registered measurement, and they are not MaleCNS physiology.

Measured under contract stage2-cellular-observables-v1 from the only unit-resolved current-step protocol in any registered source: one MBON-alpha1 cell, five 1 s square pulses at 2, 4, 6, 8 and 10 pA. Resting voltage is the median pre-step baseline across sweeps; the membrane time constant is the one post-step relaxation that passed the R squared and tau-to-window gates, at R squared 0.911; the threshold is the median voltage at which the upstroke first exceeds 10 mV/ms. Values with E provenance were not measured by this protocol and carry the fallback.

value_notes.reset_mv: Set equal to the measured resting voltage following the Shiu convention. The protocol does not resolve a separate reset level.
value_notes.refractory_ms: The shortest interspike interval observed at the highest tested current. That is an upper bound on the absolute refractory period, and using the bound as the value caps the modelled firing rate at about 63 Hz.
value_notes.membrane_tau_ms: One sweep of one cell. Four of the five sweeps were rejected: two because a spike follows step offset, two because the relaxation drifts and would have reported 239.6 ms and 102.6 ms.

default_record.biological_mismatch: A simulator fallback cannot establish whether an unregistered neuron spikes or signals with graded voltage.

records.evidence_scope: One MBON-alpha1 cell under a unit-resolved 2 to 10 pA current-step protocol, with a monotonic F-I curve of 1, 10, 17, 21 and 24 Hz and a rheobase at or below 2 pA. The MaleCNS type identifier is confirmed from the body annotation itself: MBON07 carries instance MBON07(a1).
records.biological_mismatch: One female cell in one animal. Type-level distributions, sex and the five-day-old male target condition are all unaddressed, and the reset voltage, synaptic time constant and tonic drive are not measured.

records.evidence_scope: DM1 projection-neuron electrophysiology and three published fitted passive cable models.
records.biological_mismatch: Female cross-specimen physiology; active spiking parameters remain unfitted and no MaleCNS DM1 recording exists.

records.evidence_scope: Identified DM4 projection-neuron whole-cell and ORN-to-PN synaptic physiology.
records.biological_mismatch: Female cross-specimen physiology; DM4-specific active parameters are not yet fitted.

records.evidence_scope: The registered evidence does not distinguish the DM4 vPN signaling regime.

signal_regime_policy.somatic_spike_amplitude_is_not_a_classif: Median somatic spike amplitude differs six-fold across the four measured classes, but axonal spike initiation followed by passive attenuation to the soma produces a small somatic spike in a fully spiking cell. See ADR-2026-007.
signal_regime_policy.graded_regime_is_declared_but_not_execut: No graded transmission model is registered, so an engine must refuse a graph containing neurons resolved to the graded regime rather than substitute a spiking model for them.
signal_regime_policy.unresolved_regime_is_permitted_and_count: Every unregistered cell type resolves to the unresolved regime and the engineering fallback parameters. Engines report that fraction so no run can appear to be using fitted physiology.
